gemini-3.1-pro-preview.pricingNotes: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview Standard pricing is $2/1M input tokens and $12/1M output tokens for prompts up to 200K tokens, and $4/1M input tokens and $18/1M output tokens for prompts over 200K tokens. OCR estimates switch bands from observed or heuristic input tokens; free tier, batch/flex/priority prices, context caching, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/document-processing.md.txt documents inline PDF input up to 50 MB, inline non-PDF payloads up to 100 MB, Files API uploads up to 2 GB per file, and document understanding up to 1000 PDF pages.

gemini-3.5-flash.pricingNotes: Gemini 3.5 Flash Standard pricing is $1.50/1M input tokens and $9.00/1M output tokens. OCR estimates multiply observed token usage by these published rates; free tier, batch/flex/priority prices, context caching, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

gemini-3.6-flash.pricingNotes: Gemini 3.6 Flash Standard pricing is $1.50/1M input tokens and $7.50/1M output tokens with no published context tiers. OCR estimates multiply observed token usage by these published rates. The page heuristics are reused from Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite and are provisional until a separately approved paid calibration is available; free tier, batch/flex prices, context caching, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.pricingNotes: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Standard pricing is $0.30/1M input tokens and $2.50/1M output tokens with no published context tiers. On AutoShow's 2026-08-13 project-side retirement check, Google still listed this model as the recommended replacement for gemini-3.1-flash-lite and 2027-05-07 as the old model's earliest shutdown date. OCR estimates multiply observed token usage by these published rates. The page heuristics are reused from Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite and are provisional until a separately approved paid calibration is available; free tier, batch/flex prices, context caching, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.
